relationship_history.value: Scott O'Neill remains a dormant warm relationship. The Aug. 12 call created direct access to Randy Mulato, Diego Haro, Jorge de la Parra and Terry Fresquez; Randy responded positively Aug. 21 and committed to share statements. Jorge is a key stakeholder in both payments and the DMB RFI, knows Ryan's boss Tracy, and texted Tracy shortly after the meeting.
relationship_history.strategic_implication: Jorge is the central known cross-workstream stakeholder and now has a confirmed executive relationship path into our organization. The outreach is a positive mobilization signal, but Jorge has not yet demonstrated all three Coach tests or verified Economic Buyer authority.

relationship_history.value: Global Payments/Genius submitted the DMB RFI response on 2026-08-21. Pollo Campero advanced the procurement to a formal RFP and delivered the updated TDR and SOW/pricing template on 2026-08-26. Revised response is due 2026-09-04.
relationship_history.strategic_implication: Active competitive procurement. DMB remains the primary motion; Worldpay/payments and broader Genius consolidation are optional expansion paths, not prerequisites.
